mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both decline, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during pre-recessionary environments signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In pre-recessionary environments, INDPRO decline fails to predict negative returns: 60-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC negative over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, 20-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns: 60-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC negative over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate supply-side shocks with labor market resilience, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, 20-day returns positive in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.
